_meta.description: Reason and mode vocabularies from the fleet protocol constants. Ground-side manual results add 'not_delivered', 'no_reply', 'no_telemetry' and 'invalid' (flightrisk/dashboard/manual_control.py).

assign_lanes_v1.notes: NACK_REASONS: why an edge refused assign_lanes on a v1 link. Treat any other value as text to show, never as an error.

control_modes.notes: CONTROL_MODES: fleet_status drones[].control_mode and edge_control_mode values. Treat any other value as text to show, never as an error.

edge_states.notes: EDGE_STATES: the v2 telemetry state field. Treat any other value as text to show, never as an error.

fenced_command_v2.notes: NACK_REASONS_V2: any refused fenced command on a v2 link. Treat any other value as text to show, never as an error.

hold_reasons.notes: HOLD_REASONS: the reason of a v2 hold. Treat any other value as text to show, never as an error.

manual_command.notes: MANUAL_NACK_REASONS: manual_result.reason when the edge refused. Treat any other value as text to show, never as an error.

profile_fallback.notes: PROFILE_FALLBACK_REASONS: detection_profiles drones[].fallback_reason. Treat any other value as text to show, never as an error.

set_ceiling.notes: CEILING_NACK_REASONS: ceiling_settings drones[].edge.refusal.reason. Treat any other value as text to show, never as an error.

set_detection_profile.notes: PROFILE_NACK_REASONS: detection_profiles drones[].refusal.reason. Treat any other value as text to show, never as an error.
